items.title: Serbia's veteran ruler Vučić concedes election to student-led protest movement
items.description: The populist right-wing leader of 12 years says it is "clear" his party has lost the vote billed as a referendum on the country's future.

items.title: Deeply divided Israel braces for pivotal election
items.description: After three years of regional war, this is a battle Israel always knew was coming, writes Lucy Williamson.

items.title: Venezuelan opposition leader María Machado returns after months in exile
items.description: Machado had left the country just a month before the US government seized Venezuelan President Nicolás Maduro.

items.title: Musk says SpaceX restricted Ukraine's Starlink connection as service restored
items.description: The tech billionaire accuses Ukraine of violating its terms of service by using the network for military activity.

items.title: Suspect in deadly Paris suburb shooting sent for psychiatric observation
items.description: He will be observed to evaluate whether his "psychiatric health is compatible with pursuing his interrogation", authorities said.

items.title: Israel to close West Bank crossings on election day as crackdown escalates
items.description: The Israeli Defense Forces announces restrictions on the movement of Palestinian workers in the run-up to Tuesday's election.

items.title: Gabon says access to social media restored after eight-month ban
items.description: The authorities had justified the ban by saying online content was fuelling conflict, while the opposition had condemned it as an abuse of power.

items.title: El Salvador president says bodies found in Haiti are not those of hostages
items.description: Nayib Bukele says bodies delivered to soldiers are "not our men" amid search for Salvadorans abducted last week.

items.title: Death toll in Nigeria village raided by gunmen rises to 48, police say
items.description: Unidentified gunmen on motorcycles swooped on a remote village on Friday, looting shops and setting houses ablaze.

items.title: Obama attacks Trump as he campaigns for Democrats ahead of midterm elections
items.description: Obama said the election was "the last best chance to at least rein in some of the foolishness of this administration".

items.title: More than 1,300 arrested as clashes follow another day of mass protests across France
items.description: Hundreds of thousands took part in demonstrations in France, with protests also taking place in other European countries.

items.title: Vanessa Trump says she is cancer-free six months after revealing diagnosis
items.description: The ex-wife of Donald Trump Jr, with whom she shares five children, announced in May that she had been diagnosed with breast cancer.
